name: reMarkable Ink Round-Trip
description: Keep notes in two-way sync with your reMarkable as real handwriting — in a single-line font or your own hand. Erase, move, mark up and write on the tablet, edit in Obsidian, and both sides are merged. Fork of reMarkable Round-Trip.
author: Daniel (fork of Max Kloosterman's reMarkable Round-Trip)
